correctness_argument: PR #1067 added BacterialReleasedStrainPerturbation so a bacterial strain is stored under the identifier its source released, with no lookup against an assembly (owner rule of 2026-10-12: the data is the data, and the genome never gates a record). That leaf carries no construct, so a record whose identity is a construct plus a released gene label still had to resolve the label to a locus tag of the pinned assembly before the placed leaf of its technology (BacterialCrisprInterferencePerturbation, BacterialCrisprActivationPerturbation, TransposonInsertionPerturbation) would accept it, and the placed leaves refuse a label the annotation retires, merges, shares or cannot place. Measured in the landed loaders' own retention ledgers (each pinned as an oracle on the release bytes): Cui 2018 drops 925 guides under its three gene_* rules (gene_retired_in_the_pinned_assembly 619, gene_symbol_shared_with_another_source_name 283, gene_symbol_ambiguous_in_the_pinned_assembly 23), which is 1,850 measurements over its two screens (EXPECTED_DROPS in torchcell/datasets/ecoli/cui2018.py); Rousset 2018 drops 643 records under its three symbol rules (307 + 321 + 15, notes/torchcell.datasets.ecoli.rousset2018.md retention ledger); Hawkins 2020 drops 37 rows of sokE, retired in ASM584v2 (EXPECTED_DROPS in hawkins2020.py); Fang 2025 drops 3 retired-target rows (sokEb4590_32, sokEb4700_33, ybfKb4590_11); Goodall 2018 drops 106 rows of the 9 multi-copy insertion-sequence symbols (53 per table, symbol_not_on_one_bw25113_locus); Niu 2019 drops the 2 operon labels (sufBCDS, flgFGH) and the 1 activation combination strain that names them. Total 2,642 released records refused by the genome. BacterialReleasedCrisprPerturbation stores a guide record as the placed CRISPR leaves store the construct (the shared CrisprConstruct: effector, spacer, guide count, library pool; expression_direction required with no default, since one leaf serves both effectors and the direction is a released fact) and as the strain leaf stores the gene (systematic_gene_name the released identifier verbatim, perturbed_gene_name the released name, strain_label the whole released label, identifier_kind what the identifier is, gene_namespace the study's host). BacterialReleasedTransposonPerturbation does the same with the placed transposon leaf's fields (barcode, insertion_position as released, insertion_strand, transposon, library_pool). Both are siblings of the strain leaf and of the placed bacterial leaves under GenePerturbation, both expose the mechanism SO pair the placed leaf of the technology already pins (SO:0001998 sgRNA; SO:0001218 transgenic_insertion), and both refuse a locus tag of any namespace through the shared _validate_released_identifier, so one kind of record never sits in two classes and placed records stay on the placed leaves. ConcentrationUnit.fold_change is the dimensionless member that Niu 2019's 40 pinene cells need: the release gives the product only as a ratio with and without CRISPRa, no absolute titer exists anywhere in that arm, ProductTiterPhenotype requires a ConcentrationUnit, and no existing member is true of a ratio, so the 40 cells were refused rather than stored under a unit that lies. Every change is additive: no existing leaf, field, validator or enum member changes (BacterialReleasedStrainPerturbation's own validators are byte-identical to #1067), the placed leaves keep their locus-tag contract, and the widened union and enum are what re-stale the served closures. schema_impact_check --base origin/main: 6 changed symbols (2 leaves + 2 helpers added, ConcentrationUnit gains fold_change, GenePerturbationType gains the two leaves), 115 impacted datasets in 121 loader groups stale, 0 breaking, measured at the rebased head against c40f480e5.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Loosen the locus-tag validator on the placed leaves (BacterialCrisprInterferencePerturbation, BacterialCrisprActivationPerturbation, TransposonInsertionPerturbation) so a bare symbol is accepted beside a resolution-status field
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Forbidden by schema rule 3: it weakens a required contract on served leaves (CrispriMormino2022Dataset and the served transposon stores sit on them), and it puts placed and unplaced records in one class, so a consumer could no longer tell a tag of the pinned assembly from a label nothing placed.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A crispr field (and the transposon fields) on BacterialReleasedStrainPerturbation, so one released leaf carries every technology
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The technology-per-leaf rule: a different technology is its own leaf with its own mechanism, and the strain leaf's released_kind names what a strain LABEL states (deletion, affinity tag, degron, ...), not a construct. A guide and a transposon are material entities the placed leaves of those technologies already describe; mirroring them keeps the construct described once per technology. It would also widen a leaf #1067 served, whereas two new leaves leave it byte-identical.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Place the released CRISPR leaf under ExpressionModulationPerturbation and the released transposon leaf under PresenceAbsencePerturbation, as the placed leaves are
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The three released leaves share one identity contract (a released identifier that is never a locus tag) and sit together as GenePerturbation siblings, as #1067 placed the strain leaf; the axis classes' defaults (state, mechanism SO fields) are exposed through mechanism_so instead, so nothing above the leaves changes and the placed leaves remain the only members of their axes with a locus-tag contract.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Resolve each released symbol through the annotation's synonym layer, or by positional assignment for the multi-copy IS symbols, and store the result on the placed leaves
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The genome gates records again, which the owner rule of 2026-10-12 forbids, and the ledgers show it cannot recover them: a retired gene (sokE), a merged pseudogene pair and a symbol on nine copies have no single locus to resolve to.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Store Niu 2019's 40 pinene ratios on ProductTiterPhenotype under an existing unit (g_per_l or percent) with a note, or on EnvironmentResponsePhenotype as log2_ratio
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: A unit that is not true of the number falsifies the record, and EnvironmentResponsePhenotype is a growth readout; the released number is a dimensionless product ratio, so the only honest carrier is a dimensionless unit member, which is what fold_change adds (the loader's own refusal rule names exactly this gap).
